title: How to play Bus
intro: **Welcome aboard.** The City Transit Authority has given your company a licence to run a bus line. Learn the game by playing your first rounds against Mila and Bram.

steps.welcome: This city is growing fast, and its people are always on the move: between their houses, the office, and the pub. Your company carries them there. Each passenger you deliver where they want to be is a point, and the company with the most points when the game ends wins.
steps.goal: Your points are shown here, beside your name. Everyone starts at zero.
steps.map: This is the city. Its streets meet at crossings. Your company will lay a bus line along the streets, from crossing to crossing, and your buses will only ever drive on that line.
steps.locations: The numbered circles are building locations. Each one belongs to the crossing its thin line runs to. For now only the zone 1 locations can be built on. Zone 2 opens once every zone 1 location is built, then zone 3, then zone 4.
steps.clock: The clock shows the time of day. It points at the house: right now everyone wants to be at home. Each round it moves on, from house to office to pub and round again, so the passengers keep wanting to go somewhere new.
steps.passengers: Four passengers start on the roundabouts beside Central Park. 11 passengers are waiting to be added to the board. New passengers arrive by train, at the two stations.
steps.tray: These pieces are yours. Twenty action markers: they are how you act, and once spent they are gone for good. One of your buses already stands in the depot on the board. The four more beside your markers are the buses you can still buy. And you hold the start-bus, so you go first.
steps.fb-intro: Before the first round, the city needs some buildings. Each of us puts up two, on zone 1 locations, and you choose the kind: a house, an office or a pub. Buildings never run out.
steps.fb-office-kind: First, the kind. Choose an office from the strip below: the teal disc with the briefcase. Offices are where people go when the clock shows the office.
steps.fb-office: Now tap this location to build your office there. It belongs to the crossing at the end of Modem Road, next to the roundabout where a passenger is standing.
steps.fb-house-kind: Your second building is a house: choose the cream disc with the house on it. When the clock comes round to the house, people will want to go home.
steps.fb-house: Tap this location, on the far side of the park.
steps.fb-confirm: Those are your two buildings. Tap Confirm to hand over to Mila.
steps.fl-intro: Now everyone lays the first street of their bus line: tap a street, and a line marker in your colour goes on it. The first one may go on any street at all.
steps.fl-first: Tap Modem Road, between your office's crossing and the roundabout. When the clock reaches the office, that passenger will want to get to work.
steps.fl-reverse: The second street goes round the other way: Bram, then Mila, and you last. It must grow from one end of your line, onto an empty street if that end has one.
steps.fl-second: Your turn. Tap Erie Road, from your office's crossing to the train station. New passengers arrive at the stations, and now your line reaches one.
steps.finish: That is the whole game. It is round 3, and you hold the start-bus, so you choose first. The clock will turn to the house next: think about who wants to go home, and where. Good luck!
steps.r1-round: Now the first round. It has two halves: first we all choose actions, then the actions happen, in reading order: top to bottom, and left to right along each row.
steps.r1-actions: These are the actions, top to bottom. Line Expansion lays more of your bus line. Buses buys you another bus. Passengers brings new passengers to the train stations. Buildings puts up new buildings. The Clock moves time on, or stops it. Vrrooomm! runs your buses, and scores. And the Starting Player chooses first next round.
steps.r1-choose: To choose an action you put one of your markers on it, and you must choose at least two each round. Most actions have a row of lettered spaces, and which one you get decides how much you do. Buses, the Clock and the Starting Player have only one space each.
steps.r1-vroom: Take Vrrooomm!: tap its space A. It runs your buses, and it is the only way to score. At the Clock step the clock will move on to the office, and the passenger on your roundabout will want to go to work, at the office your line now reaches.
steps.others-r1-bram1: Bram takes Line Expansion, space A.
steps.r1-buses: Now take Buses: tap its space. You get another bus, and it goes into your column of the depot, just below. Each bus carries one passenger when you run Vrrooomm!, so two buses can carry two. Buses also matters to everyone. Whoever has the most buses sets how much Passengers and Buildings do: space A does one for each of their buses, so right now one. Space B does one less, and so on. Buses happens before Passengers and Buildings, so your new bus makes their space A do two, this very round.
steps.others-r1-bram2: And Bram takes the Starting Player: whoever takes it chooses first next round.
steps.r1-pass: You have chosen two actions, so you may stop. Tap Pass. Your other markers wait for later rounds.
steps.others-r1-resolve: The others finish choosing, and the actions happen: top to bottom, left to right along each row.
steps.r1-carry: Your bus runs. Drag the passenger from your roundabout to your office. That is your first point.
steps.fl-confirm2: Tap Confirm: the lines are laid, and the first round begins.
steps.others-r1-done: Mila and Bram pass too. Now the actions happen: top to bottom, left to right along each row.
steps.others-r1-line: Line Expansion comes first. Bram is on space A, so he adds one street: nobody has more than one bus yet.
steps.others-r1-bus: Then Buses: your second bus goes into the depot. Now you have two, more than anyone, so space A of Passengers and Buildings does two.
steps.others-r1-passengers: Passengers: Mila's space A brings two new passengers, and she sets them down at the train stations.
steps.others-r1-buildings: Buildings: Mila's space A puts up two buildings, on zone 1 locations.
steps.others-r1-clock: Nobody chose the Clock, so it moves on, to the office. Now everyone wants to be at work.
steps.others-r1-reseat: Passengers at a crossing with a free office step into it. Anyone left standing wants to get away, like the passenger on your roundabout: there is no office there.
steps.r1-end: That is the end of the round. Every marker that was used goes back in the box: you have eighteen left. Then a new round begins.
steps.r2-plan: Look ahead. This round the clock will move on to the pub. Then the passenger sitting in your office will want a drink, and you have no pub on your line. So this round you will put up pubs on your roundabout, bring in new passengers, and run your buses.
steps.others-r2-bram1: Bram holds the start-bus, so he chooses first: the Clock.
steps.r2-buildings: Take Buildings, space A. This row runs F to A, so space A, on the right, happens last, but it builds the most: two.
steps.others-r2-bram2: Bram takes Line Expansion, space A.
steps.r2-passengers: Now take Passengers, space A: two new passengers, and you choose the station. This row runs A to F, so space A, on the left, goes first.
steps.others-r2-mila2: And Mila takes Line Expansion too: space B, since A is taken.
steps.r2-vroom: Finally, to run your buses once the clock has moved on, take Vrrooomm!
steps.r2-pass: Three actions is enough. Tap Pass.
steps.others-r2-done: Everyone has passed. Now the actions happen, top to bottom.
steps.others-r2-line-mila: Line Expansion runs F to A, left to right, so Mila's space B comes before Bram's A. B adds one street, one less than A.
steps.others-r2-line-bram: Then Bram's space A: two streets. A line grows only from its ends, and onto an empty street wherever that end has one.
steps.others-r2-bus: Buses: Mila buys her second bus.
steps.r2-pax1: Passengers, and your space A brings two. Tap the station at the end of your line, and a new passenger arrives there.
steps.r2-pax2: And the second one, at the same station.
steps.r2-pub1-kind: Buildings: you are on space A, so you build two. Choose a pub, the red disc with the glass and the mug.
steps.r2-pub1: Tap a location on your roundabout.
steps.others-r2-clock: The Clock is Bram's. He could stop time: take one of these time stones, worth one point less at the end, and the clock would stay at the office. He lets it run, so the clock moves on to the pub. When the last stone is taken, the game ends at once.
steps.others-r2-reseat: Now everyone wants a drink. Your passenger leaves your office and stands at its crossing, waiting for a bus, like the two at your station.
steps.r2-carry1: Vrrooomm! Each bus carries one waiting passenger, and you must carry as many as you can. Drag the one at your office's crossing to a pub on your roundabout.
steps.r2-carry2: And your second bus: drag a passenger from the station to the other pub. That makes three points.
steps.others-r2-start: Nobody chose the Starting Player, so the start-bus passes on to the left: to you.
steps.others-r2-bram-build: Bram's space B is left of your A, so he builds first: one building, one less than A.
steps.close-lines: A few rules have not come up yet. Your line always grows from one of its two ends, onto an empty street if that end has one. If an end has no empty street, you may run alongside another line there instead. And where your end meets another player's end, you may run alongside their line for one street, even if empty streets are left. Never alongside your own line.
steps.close-loops: A line may loop back and cross itself, but it can never use a street twice. When one of its ends lands on a crossing the line already passes, a spent action marker stands beside that crossing, to show everyone where the end is.
steps.close-zones: Zone 1 has one free location left. Once it is built, zone 2 opens, then zone 3 and zone 4. When every location is built, the game ends after that round.
steps.close-end: The game can end in three ways. At once, when the last time stone leaves the clock. After the round in which every building location is built. Or after a round in which only one player, or nobody, has action markers left.
steps.close-score: At the end, every time stone you took costs one point. The most points wins. On a tie, the player with more time stones wins, and if that is tied too, whoever reached that score first.
steps.close-aid: The player aid, up here, shows what each action space would do right now, the clock, and the scores so far. Open it whenever you like.
steps.others-r1-start: Last comes the Starting Player. Bram chose it, so he takes the start-bus and chooses first next round.
